title: Japan 20-Year JGB auction (¥700bn anticipated) — the tenor the BoJ tapered by 55%, and the direct test of the bucket mechanism
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) by the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 initial research, whose table row reads 'Oct. 20, 2026 | 20-year'. The size is anticipated, not announced — that row carries no announcement href on 2026-09-08 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-10-13. The ¥700bn anticipated size comes from a second MOF primary, the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, downloaded and parsed 2026-09-08): the 20-year runs monthly and MOF cut it from ¥1,000bn to ¥800bn on 2025-07-10 and to ¥700bn from 2026-04-14, where it has stayed for every auction through 2026-07-14. Filed `estimate` on the same two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Discovered during the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08) on MOF's own October calendar. It earns a slot on one term: it is the cleanest falsification vehicle for that ledger's load-bearing mechanism. The 30-year research measured, from 16 monthly BoJ operation files (boj.or.jp/en/statistics/boj/fm/ope/m_release, 2024-01 -> 2026-08), that the BoJ's taper has fallen ENTIRELY on the 'More than 10 years and up to 25 years' bucket — ¥450bn a month down to ¥200bn, -55%, operation count 3 -> 2 — while the 'More than 25 years' bucket has been flat at ¥150bn every single month without exception. A newly issued 20-year sits in the tapered bucket; a 30-year and a 40-year sit in the untapered one. That is the proposed mechanism for why 20s30s stands at its 73.7th percentile (+25.8bp) while 30s40s stands at its 1.7th (+0.4bp) — the segment that lost its buyer cheapened and the segment that kept it did not. If the mechanism is real, the 20-year is the tenor where auction demand should deteriorate first, and 10-20 is the next observation. This calendar tracks only jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15, which prices before the 10-08 30-year and therefore cannot test the sequence. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` on the evidence the 30-year ledger measured at the neighbouring tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, and the JGB-auction-to-US-long-end spillover is an association that does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move (partial corr +0.109, t = +1.52) and leaves nothing at D+1. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
